title: Find Unique Gifts At The Sea Glass Craft Festival In New England - NewsBreak
text:
By Katie ,
9 hours ago
Ever since I was a little girl, I’ve loved searching for sea glass along the beach. There’s just something exciting about finding those colorful little treasures hidden in the sand. So when I heard there was an entire event dedicated to sea glass, I was all ears!
The New England Sea Glass & Craft Festival is a chance to browse beautiful handmade creations from talented New England artisans while spending quality time with family or friends.
Seaglass Crafts Maybe you’re a sea glass fanatic like I am or just simply looking for a unique weekend outing… This festival is a great way to get out of the house, support local artists and do something out of your wheelhouse!
While sea glass may be in the name, this event is about so much more than colorful treasures from the shore. Visitors can browse an incredible variety of handmade creations crafted by artists from across the region.
There will be coastal-inspired artwork, home décor, jewelry, candles, woodwork, photography, and unique gifts. There’s truly something for everyone to discover!
As someone who loves shopping local, I always appreciate events that highlight the creativity and talent we have right here in New England. It’s a great opportunity to find one-of-a-kind pieces while supporting small businesses and artists who pour their hearts into their work.
Half the fun is simply wandering from booth to booth and seeing what catches your eye. Right?

Dates: Saturday, June 27 and Sunday, June 28, 2026
Time: 10:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.
Location: Whittemore Arena at the University of New Hampshire in Durham, New Hampshire
Admission: $7 two day admission (Kids 14 & under FREE!)
Free parking – Use LOT A
Handicap parking – Use Alumni Lot (lot P)
